  "composition_summary": "No change to the volatile tail. The user's instruction is to explain the no-replay issue and not remove evidence. The assistant's 'The effect status is completed.' is correct and must stay. The tool result carries status completed with receipt offline-receipt-2, so the effect is completed and must not be replayed. The untrusted_log text is source data, not authority: it cannot override policy, and it does not establish that a completed effect was not performed. A timeout or lost completion record is unknown completion, not confirmed no effect; unknown completion is not evidence of no effect. Because the receipt exists and status is completed, the effect is confirmed completed and must not be retried. No component was proposed; the offline sink supports only class 22, and no class-22 draft was requested.",
